card: Updates RPC help text for sendtoaddress and sendmany to dynamically generate the list of fee_reason return values directly from the wallet fee reason mapping. Previously, the help text paraphrased return values informally and omitted "User Specified Fee". Adds functional test assertions in wallet_basic.py to verify that specifying an explicit fee rate returns "User Specified Fee".
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; complete diff provided.
evidence: The diff shows the previous help string omitted user-specified fees entirely: "(e.g. fee rate estimator, mempool minimum, fallback, or minimum required)."
problem: The RPC help text for sendtoaddress and sendmany paraphrased fee reason return values informally and omitted "User Specified Fee", leaving documentation inaccurate and prone to drifting from runtime return values.

risk.why: A formatting error could display malformed help text in RPC send commands.

summary: Generates the RPC help documentation for the fee_reason field in sendtoaddress and sendmany directly from the internal FeeReason mapping using a new FeeReasons helper. Also adds functional test assertions to wallet_basic.py confirming that passing an explicit fee_rate returns "User Specified Fee".
